content.short: AirSwap is a decentralized exchange enabling peer-to-peer trading with atomic swaps, and a DAO-based governance model.
content.description: AirSwap is a decentralized exchange that enables peer-to-peer trading through atomic swaps on Ethereum and Layer-2 networks (including Polygon). It also works with popular automated market makers like 1inch and Uniswap by accessing their liquidity through AirSwap's request-for-quote protocol. Governance is handled by the AirSwap DAO, which stakes AST, the native token, to participate in network decisions.
